h.Quando alguém busca \"padaria perto de m: When someone searches "bakery near me" or "auto repair in [your city]", Google Maps highlights three businesses — the so-called local pack. Whoever is there gets the overwhelming majority of clicks, calls and visits. Whoever is below fights over the leftovers.
h.A pergunta que todo dono de negócio faz:: The question every business owner asks: what decides who shows up at the top?
h.Relevância é o quanto seu perfil corresp: Relevance is how well your profile matches what the person searched for. Google only shows you for "artisan bakery" if your profile says and demonstrates that you're an artisan bakery.
h.Categoria principal certa — é o fator is: The right primary category — it's the single most important factor in your profile. "Bakery" and "Artisan bakery" are different categories, with different rankings. Choose the one that exactly describes your main business and add secondary categories for your other services.
h.Descrição completa com os termos que seu: A complete description with the terms your customers use (without overdoing it — writing the keyword 15 times doesn't help and can get you penalized).
h.Produtos e serviços cadastrados no perfi: Products and services listed on your profile, with real names.
h.Perfil 100% preenchido: horários, telefo: Profile 100% filled in: hours, phone, website, photos, attributes. All else being equal, incomplete profiles lose to complete ones.
h.Defina corretamente sua área de cobertur: Set your service area correctly on your profile (if you serve customers at home or deliver).
h.Mantenha o endereço exato e consistente: Keep your address exact and consistent everywhere: website, social media, directories. Address inconsistencies confuse Google and dilute your local relevance.
h.Proeminência é a reputação: o quanto o G: Prominence is reputation: how much Google perceives your business as well-known and well-rated. And this is where the factor that moves positions most in the short term lives: reviews.
h.Recência e frequência — 10 avaliações po: Recency and frequency — 10 reviews a month, every month, is worth more than 100 old reviews sitting still. A recent review tells Google the business is alive and relevant now
h.Conteúdo — avaliações com texto (e que c: Content — reviews with text (that mention services/products) reinforce your relevance for searches
h.Respostas — negócios que respondem avali: Replies — businesses that reply to reviews signal active management; Google itself recommends replying to all of them, including the positive ones
h.Crie um fluxo constante de avaliações. N: Create a steady flow of reviews. One-off campaigns don't work: the algorithm rewards frequency. The most effective way is to remove friction at the moment the customer is happy and present — a tap of the phone on the NFC counter stand or a QR code on the table turns satisfaction into a review before it fades on the way home.
h.Responda tudo, em até 48h. Positivas com: Reply to everything within 48h. Positive ones with a brief, personal thank-you; negative ones calmly, with a solution and an invitation to sort it out privately.
h.Nunca compre avaliações. O Google detect: Never buy reviews. Google detects artificial patterns, removes them en masse and can suspend your profile. Besides being illegal (misleading advertising), it's the most expensive shortcut there is: you pay to destroy your own prominence.
h.Muitos perfis fazem tudo \"certo\" e não: Many profiles do everything "right" and still don't climb for a reason the owner can't see: the wrong category or the wrong comparison. The business sees itself as an "artisan bakery", but Google classifies it as a "bakery" — and it competes in a ranking where it doesn't even show up for people searching the specific term.
h.Descobrir como o Google realmente enxerg: Finding out how Google really sees and classifies your business — and whom you're actually competing against in your area — is the first diagnosis to run before investing in any optimization.
